name: Additional Service 3
definition: Additional functions or services that have been or are to be performed in conjunction with the transaction.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of additional service applied to the transaction. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

SubType.name: Sub Type
SubType.definition: Sub type of the additional service.

Result.name: Result
Result.definition: Result from performing the identified service.

Detail.name: Detail
Detail.definition: Contains additional information for the execution or results of the service.
